name: Summit AZ - Work Reports Sep 2026
body:
> Report · Summit Az · 2026-09-10

# Summary
Three early-September work reports written in the work-report format (problem, what was done, result, pending). Daily EOD reports are a separate set (see [EOD Reports Index](lib:brain-eod-reports-index)).

# Sep 1: ranking tracker and supporting blog cluster (`Summit-AZ-Work-Report-2026-09-01.md`)
- GSC Jul 1 to Aug 30 swept page by page; position 2 was almost all branded; the brand term was cannibalized by 6 pages.
- Built the position 2 and 3 to 5 trackers and the supporting blog strategy; dropped the roof drain target (not a Summit service).
- Blog 1 "Old and Cracked Pipes in Scottsdale Homes" published (post 6108); Blog 2 (sewer repair vs replacement, post 6111) scheduled for Sep 3 (briefly published by accident during scheduling, then reverted).
- Found /sewer-line-repair-san-tan-valley/ was the strongest page (14 keywords at positions 2 to 5).
- Pending: OTTO meta for the new blog was blocked (OTTO crawl frequency "Never", GSC not connected), two cannibalization fixes, blogs 3 to 5.

# Sep 8: website fixes and SEO baseline (`Summit-AZ-Work-Report-2026-09-08.txt`)
- Baseline crawl: 199 pages, 9 internal links to 404s, 22 links via redirects, 7 service pages with no in-content links, 128 pages with two H1s, 363 images without alt, 108 long titles, 0 breadcrumb schema.
- Fixes: footer black bullets (Code Snippets 24); duplicate lead forms removed on 116 pages; the 8-page form swap was restored after Kim confirmed the older custom form is the design Scott wants (no net change); broken links fixed (an AI-tool domain on Terms, dead tankless city links, phone numbers used as URLs on 9 pipe lining pages, dead Energy.gov citations).
- Emergency page restyle built as a draft only, wording verified identical; Kim to apply manually.

# Sep 10: blog work (`Summit-AZ-Work-Report-2026-09-10.md`)
- Killed a hard water draft that duplicated an August post; fixed and published the garbage disposal post on an informational keyword.
- Turned on the existing FAQ dropdown feature and added FAQ schema to 26 posts (and restored the Article schema it had displaced).
- Blog author changed from "scott-vincent" to "Summit Plumbing Pros" on 28 posts; Rank Math sitemap cache cleared so new posts appear.
- Pending: hard water draft decision, OTTO pixel question, dead energy.gov links on 2 posts.
